reviews.text: I stopped by quickly for my son's birthday. It seemed very well-kept.

We looked for a daycare center for our "little" Thor and came across this magical place. We couldn't have made a better choice.
Manuela is wonderful, cuddly, and attentive to everything. She immediately inspired so much trust in us. You can tell she does this job with extreme passion and professionalism.
Thor recognizes the road and is happy, and this says more than our words. When he gets home, he falls into a deep sleep.
I highly recommend it.
Welcoming nursery, super helpful with both people and dogs

Pluto's Park is a wonderful place for four-legged friends. In addition to the dog daycare, it has several play areas and the option of renting the entire area on the weekends, complete with barbecues, relaxation areas, and doggie wading pools—all fenced and secure. Highly recommended!

Wonderful place where I took my Candy today for the first time, I had a great time and the puppy settled in immediately, wonderful and very kind people, they kept me updated on everything during the day, you can see they love animals, we will definitely be back 😍 …
I recommend this nursery to anyone looking for a safe, reliable place filled with people who truly care for this job. 😘♥️ …

Wonderful place, with greenery, shade, and pools. It's become my Shira's favorite place. The dogs are cared for, loved, and their every need is understood, thanks to Manuela and Giampaolo.
They learn to socialize and have a blast.

I discovered Pluto's Park and its delightful owners after a bad experience at another local daycare. The park is huge, well-kept, and they are very dedicated to the dogs. Every time Flash recognizes the road, he sticks his nose to the car window, eager to run with his friends! My experience has been very positive. I find the option of packages and hourly admissions very convenient. The love for animals is palpable. Manuela and Giampaolo are lovely, helpful, and attentive people. I'm so happy to have met them! Oh, and that's Flash in the photo after a day at daycare...

I stumbled upon this place by chance and stopped to ask for information about my 8-year-old wolf, Zoe. I was greeted with great courtesy and enthusiasm by the lovely Manuela and her husband. After chatting with Manuela for a while and touring this well-kept, shaded park, I decided to try the nursery the next day, and what can I say...they exceeded my expectations! Zoe had a wonderful time! Manuela updated me with videos throughout the morning, which confirmed how much fun Zoe was having! Thanks also to Valentina, who was a great help at the nursery!

Our first experience at daycare with Lillo, our entire male Lagotto; we spent an induction day at this facility, which we found clean, spacious, and, above all, managed with love and professionalism. After raising some concerns about sharing space with other males, Emanuela quickly reassured us by offering an "on-call" option, which we honestly appreciated. They showed us they don't want to "profit" on the dogs, but rather prioritize everyone's peace of mind (including us, the owners) over a few euros. For me, this is synonymous with professionalism and competence, and for that we thank them!!!!
Of course, when Lillo returns from daycare, he's so happy that... he sleeps like a little angel :)
